reviews.text: This was my first visit. The shop was clean and cute. The explanation was thorough, and I was very satisfied with the result, especially the haircut, which is the most important part.

This is my second visit! 💖
Thank you so much for always making her look so adorable.
Ruby-chan went home with a smile. I look forward to seeing you again! ❤️ …

I visited for my beloved dog's first grooming session 🐶✂️✨

Even though she's a long-haired Chihuahua, I was worried about her coat texture, wondering if it was normal for it to be so coarse. But after the grooming, her coat texture had truly transformed, and I was so happy! 🥹✨

I was impressed by the effects of the C-CELL’ LINO (a treatment only available at select salons) and ozone, but above all, the staff's meticulous care for my dog ​​was truly wonderful. I was surprised at how blissful she looked during the nail trimming! (lol)

The pre-grooming consultation was very thorough, and I felt completely at ease leaving my dog ​​in their care for her first grooming session. ✨

They also kept a video and photos of her first grooming session, which is a wonderful memento. 📷✨
Thank you so much! ♥️

I wish I could have taken my previous dog to such a wonderful grooming salon as JINGU Prize…


I'm so grateful for this wonderful salon and the wonderful people I met ♥️

I hope you'll continue to take good care of my dog ​​in the future 🐾✨

I requested a shampoo.

The result was incredibly fluffy, and my dog ​​seemed to enjoy it so much, which made me very happy as her owner.

I was also very pleased with the adorable photos taken during and after the shampoo!
This is a salon my dog ​​loves to visit every time we go for a walk. Thank you so much for always being so kind to her!
The treatment and service were fantastic, and my dog ​​seemed very happy! We'll definitely be back!

After using it a few times...
What kind of place is it? = A clean and pleasant place
What kind of people are there? = Beautiful ladies who are kind to you
Is it safe and secure even without the owner? = No problem
Will the owner come to pick her up eventually? = Absolutely!
It seems that all the conditions have been met.
As soon as we arrived, her tail was held high and she went straight inside...lol
She seems to really like it.
As the owner, I felt a little sad watching her go...🥹

I requested grooming for my two brothers.

Both of them had a lot of matted fur, which must have been difficult, but the staff's smiles put them both at ease, and they came home very happy. I would definitely like to use their services again! ♡

This place is truly an oasis for dogs! Even my shy dog ​​has settled in.

It's a wonderful shop overflowing with the staff's and owner's love for dogs.

This was my second time using their services ☺️
Last time, I searched for a salon near my workplace and booked one based on the reviews and the cleanliness of the shop...! My dog ​​is 8 years old, but I finally found a groomer with skills I'm happy with 😳!!

They have high technical skills and a great sense of style!!

They created a cute video for my first visit and posted it on Instagram Reels, which my friends praised, making me very happy.

There's also a veterinary clinic on the floor below, so I'm thinking of getting my dog's rabies and other vaccinations there next year.

It's really helpful that it's close to my workplace so I can go during my work breaks.

I'll definitely be using their services again in the future ♡

Thank you again today!

This salon makes lots of dogs and cats look adorable!

I highly recommend everyone try it at least once!

I'm the mom of a 15-year-old senior dog 🐶✨
She has a health condition that causes her health to fluctuate, but they always adjust to her pace, giving her breaks as needed during shampooing and grooming. It's a grooming salon I can entrust my dog ​​to with complete peace of mind and trust.

Here, they truly focus on each individual dog, providing careful care tailored to their personality and health. The staff are all incredibly kind, and I feel at ease seeing my dog's relaxed expression each time. The owner's passionate desire for "the happiness of dogs and their owners" permeates the entire salon, and I'm always impressed by their commitment to prioritizing "love" and "trust" over profit in the fashionable Omotesando area. I'll continue to support them!

I'm the one who called you suddenly the day before, but thank you so much for your very kind and helpful response.

I only had my dog's nails trimmed, but a very kind and lovely lady did it for me!

I would definitely like to book another appointment for grooming in the future. 🩵

Thank you very much! 🐶
I am always grateful for the polite service and skillful trimming.
I've been coming here because all the staff are so wonderful ♡ I look forward to continuing to use your services.

Despite it being her first grooming session at just four months old, she behaved very well and calmly.

The groomer must have been incredibly kind.

The haircut was adorable, and both my dog ​​and I are very happy with the result.

We would definitely like to use their services again next time.

I have a two-year-old Japanese Spitz/Shih Tzu mix. I get my dog ​​shampooed and cut every month.
My dog ​​loves Jingu Prize, so much so that he makes a dash to the salon whenever he passes by on a walk ♪ I can see from this how much love they treat him, and they're also very kind to me, the owner, so I can leave him there with peace of mind. Thank you so much as always!
There's a hospital on site, so I can rest assured that they will work with the veterinarian if there are any health issues.

They also take adorable photos after the trim, so I look forward to them every month.
I'm glad I found a salon that will watch over my dog ​​as he grows. I look forward to their continued support ♪
I ordered a shampoo for my French bulldog. After the shampoo, the coat was smooth and the price was reasonable compared to other salons. You can eat on the first floor while you wait.
It was a great groomer👍Thank you♪I'll come again♪ …

I requested the skincare shampoo and cut course.

They were very kind and attentive, and once again, they gave my dog ​​a lovely finish.

This is a polite shop that is kind to both owners and dogs! 
Seeing the dogs always look so cute and beautiful makes us feel happy too.
It was my first time, but they did a really cute job. It was clear that everyone involved loves animals, which made me feel at ease leaving my pet in their care.

They did exactly what I wanted and my dog ​​looks so cute!
I'm so happy that her dry skin is now moisturized ✨
The groomer's love for animals was so evident, and I felt completely at ease leaving my dog ​​with them. I'm also happy to hear that they had lots of fun playing with her (^ ^) Thank you so much ✨

I was curious about the shampoo that uses ozone and carbon dioxide, so I tried it for the first time.
The female staff member explained the course clearly and politely, and the atmosphere was very pleasant and pet-friendly.
I was very satisfied with the results, so I will definitely use their services again.
The staff always greet me with kind smiles, so I feel at ease leaving my dog ​​in their care. …
